title: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme - Framework for Customer Complaint Resolution
description: <cite index="45-3,45-4">The RBI's revised Integrated Ombudsman Scheme has come into effect, introducing updated rules for resolving customer complaints against banks, select NBFCs, prepaid payment instrument issuers and credit information companies. The new framework replaces the 2021 scheme and aims to provide a faster, free and customer-friendly mechanism for addressing service-related complaints.</cite>
